s: Din birkat hayyayin basseuda, ubo y"a seipim: yayin, ap al pi shebba lishtot tok hasseuda, mebarek alayv "bore peri haggapen", veeno niptar bebirkat happat, ap al pi sheshshoteh lishrot haakila shebbemeayv vahare zeh kidbarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda betok hasseuda shenniptarim bebirkat happat, kemo shennitbaer, mikkol maqom, hoil vehayyayin hu chashub sheggorem beraka leatzmo bekamma meqomot, kegon beqiddush vehabdala ubirkat erusin, shemmebarekin al hayyayin "bore peri haggapen" ap al pi sheen tzerikim lishtiyyato, lepikak eno nechshab tapel lappat lehippater bebirkato mibberaka rishona shehi "bore peri haggapen", ap al pi shettapel eleha lehippater bebirkat hammazon mibberaka acharona, lepi sheeno gorem leatzmo beraka acharona ella beraka rishona (lebaddah, shebbishbilah hi iqqar habaat hakkos bekol dabar hattaun kos):

Abal al mayim o shear mashqim — en lebarek alehem betok hasseuda, vaapillu shoteh litzmao, lepi shehem baim mechamat hasseuda, shei epshar laakila belo shetiyya. Vegam im okel ezeh dabar lematteq hashshetiyya — hare zeh tapel lammashqeh vehammashqeh lallechem, veniptarim bebirkat hallechem. Vaapillu im haya tzame qodem hasseuda, kevan shello ratza lishtot az kede shello yazziqu lo hammayim — nimtza ki shetiyyat hammayim besibbat happat hi, ubirkat happat potartam. (Veap al pi shehappat hi sibba rechoqa lahem, veenam domim leperot sheokelim bigmar hasseuda leakkel hammaakal, shehappat hu sibba qeroba lahem, veap al pi ken teunim beraka lipnehem, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"z, lepi shehapperot hem debarim habbaim shello mechamat hasseuda, shedderek leoklam kol hayyom, lepikak im okelam bishat seuda enam chashubim tepela lappat, ella im ken bau letzorek akilatah sheyyokal adayin, kegon lelappet happat, o leorer taavat hammaakal, kemo sheyyitbaer, velo leakkel hammaakal shekkebar akal, ki mah shehaya kebar haya, abal mayim ushear mashqin sheshshetiyyatam kol hayyom hi mechamat seuda, sherob hatztzimmaon hi mechamat akila. Vaapillu mashqin sheshshotin otam apillu shello letzimmaon, kegon shekar ume debash — en darkam lishtotam qodem akila ella achareha, nimtza shebbaim mechamat akila, lepikak keshebbaim betok hasseuda apillu al yede sibba rechoqa — hare hem tepelim lasseuda, ubirkat happat shehu iqqar hasseuda potartam). Vehu sheqqobea seuda al pat, abal im okel meat pat bishbil shello yazziqu lo hammayim bilbad — mebarek al happat "shehakkol", kemo sheyyitbaer:

Veyen sarap shebbetok hasseuda, im shotehu kede leorer taavat hammaakal — hare hu tapel lasseuda veeno tzarik lebarek alayv. Veim shotehu kede lechammem haitztomeka leakkel hammaakal — tzarik lebarek alayv (kemo shetztzarik lebarek al happerot shebbaim leakkel), lepi sheggam hayyen sarap en shetiyyato mechamat akila leolam kishar mashqin, vegam en kavvanat rob bene adam leorer bo taavat hammaakal, shehare regilim lishtoto bekol boqer ap belo seuda, lepikak eno nechshab tapel ella keshebba letzorek akila sheyyokal adayin. Veim shoreh bo pat — yitbaer leqamman. Ubeshabbat en tzarik lebarek alayv bekol inyan, shenniptar bebirkat hakkos shel qiddush, vaapillu qiddesh al hayyayin, kemo sheyyitbaer (ella im ken qiddesh ballayla al happat). Veyesh omerim, sheggam mayim ushear mashqim teunim beraka betok hasseuda kemo yayin, velo hutzreku litten taam lebirkat hayyayin mippene sheggorem beraka leatzmo ella mippene shehayyayin mamshik adam letaavat akila vahare hu tzorek seuda, abal shear mashqim sheenan meorerim taavat hammaakal — tzarik lebarek alehem ap al pi sheenan chashubin keyayin. Veyesh matzrikim od lebarek al hammayim bekol paam upaam, ki min hassetam nimlak hu bekol paam, lepi sheen derek lishtot mayim ella litzmao velo haya yodea sheyyitzma od. Vehaiqqar kassebara harishona. Veharotzeh lehistalleq min hassapeq — yitten leacher sheeno okel lebarek veyitkavven lepotro, o yesheb qodem netila bimqom seudato vibarek al meat mayim o shear mashqin al daat lishtot kol tzorko betok seudato (vaapillu im nimlak lishtot od lipne hasseuda — en tzarik lebarek, sheen zeh qaruy nimlak, kevan shehaya bedato lishtot achar kak basseuda al semak birkato zo). Velo yishteh keshiur rebiit, shello yitztarek lebarek beraka acharona, al derek sheyyitbaer, velo yiptor bazeh mah sheyyishteh betok seudato. Vegam yizzaher shello latzet chutza qodem seuda, shekkeshemmeshanneh meqomo — tzarik lachazor ulebarek keshechozer limqomo, kemo sheyyitbaer leqamman. Abal hamminhag kassebara harishona:

Berak al yayin — en tzarik lebarek al shear mashqin ledibre hakkol, sheyyayin poter kol mine mashqim, ben bishat hasseuda ben bishar peamim, lepi shehayyayin hu iqqar mashqeh vehu rosh lekol mine mashqin, laken hu iqqar leinyan beraka vekullan tepelim elayv. Vehu shehayu hammashqin lepanayv beshaa shebberak al hayyayin (o shehaya dato alehem). Vaapillu eno qobea atzmo lishtot yayin, ella shoteh yayin meat letzorek mitzva, kegon qiddush vehabdala, veshoteh mashqin harbeh achar kak — niptarim bebirkat hayyayin (im haya dato alehem, ukemo sheyyitbaer):

Im shata yayin lipne hasseuda, apillu qodem sheqqaba atzmo lasseuda — en tzarik lebarek al hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda, shenniptar bebirkat hayyayin shellipne hasseuda, ella im ken lo haya bedato techilla lishtot yayin betok hasseuda veachar kak nimlak. Abal bistam eno niqra nimlak, ki regilut hu lishtot yayin basseuda apillu bechol lishrot haakila shebbemeayv. Velaken hammabdil al shulchano, dehaynu samuk lisudato ubimqom seuda — en tzarik lebarek al hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda. Veyesh omerim sheyyen habdala hoil veeno ba lishtiyya ella lemitzva — eno poter hayyayin shebbasseuda, ella im ken hibdil al shulchano mammash, dehaynu achar sheqqaba atzmo lasseuda al hashshulchan, o achar shennatal yadayv, shennetilat yadayim hi hatchalat qebiut hasseuda, ap al pi shello yashab bashshulchan adayin, vaapillu natal yadayv vehibdil becheder acher (veal derek sheyyitbaer). Veyesh lachosh ledibrehem lekattechilla, shekkeshemmabdil qodem sheqqobea atzmo lisuda — yekavven shello liptor bibraka zo hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda. Ubediabad shello kivven lekak — en tzarik lebarek al hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda, shessepeq berakot shel dibre soperim lehaqel. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyen habdala sheeno shayyak lasseuda, abal yen qiddush hoil vehu shayyak lasseuda, sheen qiddush ella bimqom seuda — poter hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda ledibre hakkol, apillu qiddesh qodem sheqqaba atzmo lasseuda, ap al pi sheyyayin zeh eno lishtiyya ella lemitzva. Vekol shekken yayin shellipne hasseuda bechol shehu lishtiyya sheppoter hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda, apillu im berak alayv qodem sheqqaba atzmo lasseuda. (Vehu shebberak bimqom seuda, dehaynu beoto cheder shessoed bo, abal mecheder lecheder — tzarik lachazor ulebarek, ella im ken shata keshiur shennitchayyeb lebarek beraka achat meen g' velo berak, sheaz yesh omerim sheen tzarik lachazor ulebarek, veyesh lismok al dibrehem bediabad, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"ch. Vaapillu beoto cheder, im yatza mimmennu benetayim vechazar — hare dino kemecheder lecheder, kemo sheyyitbaer sham). Bammeh debarim amurim? Bistam, abal im haya bedato beperush keshebberak al hayyayin becheder zeh liptor bibraka zo et hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda sheyyisod becheder acher — poter apillu lekattechilla im shene hachadarim hem bebayit echad, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:

Vekol maqom sheyyayin shellipne hasseuda poter et hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda — en tzarik lebarek leacharayv beraka acharona kelal, apillu shata lipne hasseuda kashshiur, lepi shenniptar hu bebirkat hammazon kemo hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda sheshshenehem hem shetiyya achat, kevan shennipteru bibraka rishona achat. Abal hammabdil lipne hasseuda vekivven shello liptor hayyayin shebbetok hasseuda, o sheen bedato kelal lishtot yayin betok hasseuda — tzarik lebarek acharayv beraka acharona lipne hasseuda im shata kashshiur (veim shakach velo berak lipne hasseuda venizkar qodem birkat hammazon — tzarik lebarek miyyad "meen g'"). Veim lo nizkar ad leachar birkat hammazon — en tzarik lebarek, shebbirkat hammazon poteret "meen g'" al hayyayin bediabad, kemo sheyyitbaer. Bammeh debarim amurim? Beyen habdala, sheeno ella lemitzva, abal hashshoteh yayin lipne hasseuda bechol — en tzarik lebarek acharayv, apillu en bedato kelal lishtot yayin betok hasseuda, lepi sheyyayin shellipne hasseuda ba liptoach bene meayim lehamshik adam letaavat akila, umikkelal hasseuda hu, laken niptar bebirkat hammazon kishar debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda. Vehu haddin leyen sarap. Abal hashshoteh shear mashqin lipne hasseuda bechol — tzarik lebarek acharehem, vaapillu dato lishtot gam ken betok hasseuda, kevan sheeno poter bebirkat hammashqin shellipne hasseuda et hammashqin shebbetok hasseuda mibberaka rishona, shehare shear mashqin shebbetok hasseuda en tzerikim beraka kelal (veim shakach velo berak venizkar apillu achar birkat hammazon — tzarik lebarek, shebbirkat hammazon enah poteret "bore nepashot rabbot" apillu bediabad):

Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheen lo kos lebirkat hammazon, abal im dato lebarek birkat hammazon al hakkos — en tzarik lebarek kelal beraka acharona al hammashqin shellipne hasseuda apillu lekattechilla, lepi shenniptarim bibraka acharona sheyyebarek achar hakkos shel birkat hammazon. Umikkol maqom, yishteh pachot merebiit lipne hasseuda, ubazeh yistalleq min hassapeq. Veim shata rebiit — yihyeh lo kos lebirkat hammazon lebarek acharayv beraka acharona liptor mashqin sheshshata lipne hasseuda, im rotzeh lehistalleq missepeq sebarat hammatzrikim beraka lemashqin, kemo shennitbaer, shellepi dibrehem en tzarik lebarek achar mashqin shellipne hasseuda, kevan shehem poterim et hammashqin shebbetok hasseuda mibberaka rishona:

Vekol zeh bechol, abal beshabbat veyom tob shemmeqaddesh al hakkos — en tzarik lebarek acharayv ledibre hakkol, apillu hu shel shear mashqin, lepi shehu shayyak lasseuda, sheen qiddush ella bimqom seuda, velaken niptar bebirkat hammazon kemo yayin shellipne hasseuda shehu ba mechamat hasseuda. Veeno domeh lidbarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda leachar hasseuda qodem birkat hammazon, kemo shehayu regilim bimehem achar gemar hasseuda limshok yedehem min happat veliqboa laakilat perot velishtiyya, vekol dabar shemmebiim az lipnehem, apillu debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda, kegon mine liptan umine yeraqot shenneekalim lemazon ulesoba velo leqinnuach uletaanug, veap al pi ken teunim gam beraka acharona, veenan niptarim bebirkat hammazon, hoil velo bau betok iqqar hasseuda, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman qa"z, lepi shekkol mah shebba leachar shekkebar sillequ yedehem min happat, eno nechshab tapel lappat lehippater immah bebirkoteha, shehen "hammotzi" ubirkat hammazon, abal debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda beshaa sheddatam al happat veen yedehem mesullaqot hemenna, ap al pi sheadayin lo hitchilu bah — hem tepelim eleha lehippater bebirkatah mibberaka acharona. Abal lo mibberaka rishona, shello lehanot mehaolam hazzeh belo beraka bitchilla, kemo sheyyitbaer sham:

Vaapillu yayin habba lipnehem leachar shekkebar masheku yedehem min happat — en tzarik lebarek leacharayv, shenniptar bebirkat hammazon, ap al pi sheeno nechshab mikkelal hasseuda, lepi shekkevan shehayyayin soed halleb — haya rauy letaqqen lebarek acharayv shalosh berakot gemurot kemo achar happat, ella mippene sheen derek bene adam liqboa seuda alayv day lo be"meen g'", abal kesheshshotehu bisuda shel qeba, mittok shehi qebiut laakila — hare zo qebiut lishtiyya, veniptar bebirkat hammazon apillu lekattechilla. Abal shear mashqin achar gemar hasseuda leachar shemmasheku yedehem min happat — teunim beraka leacharehem. Uleqamman siman qa"z yitbaer im shayyak bimdinatenu din zeh shelleachar hasseuda. (Veap bimehem) lo hayu tzerikim lebarek beraka rishona al hayyayin shelleachar hasseuda qodem birkat hammazon, lepi shenniptar bebirkat hayyayin shellipne hasseuda, im haya bedato az lishtot gam achar hasseuda, o apillu bistam, im hu shabbat o yom tob o yom haqqaza o yom shenniknas lammerchatz, shessetam kol adam darko liqboa seudato al hayyayin beyamim ellu, ap bimqomot sheen hayyayin matzuy kol kak, velaken eno niqra nimlak min hassetam, ella im ken yodea beatzmo shehu nimlak. Abal im lo berak al yayin lipne hasseuda ella betok hasseuda — eno poter bistam et hayyayin shelleachar hasseuda, ella im ken nitkavven lepotro beperush, lepi shehayyayin shebbetok hasseuda shetiyyato gerua, sheeno ba lishtiyya ella lishrot haakila shebbemeayv, shello hayu regilin lishtot betok hasseuda ella meat lishrot bilbad, vehayyayin shelleachar hasseuda hu ba lishtiyya, veeno bedin sheyyiptor haggarua et hechashub shello bekavvana. Veakshav sheen anu regilim limshok yadenu min happat ad birkat hammazon — hare gam hayyayin shelleachar gemar hasseuda hu ba lishrot, veniptar bebirkat yayin shebbetok hasseuda. (Raq bisudot gedolot shergilim limshok yedehem min happat velaarok hashshulchan bemine megadim veliqboa shetiyya qodem birkat hammazon — en hayyayin niptar bebirkat hayyayin shebberak betok hasseuda, ella im ken haya bedato lepotro. Abal al shear mashqim en tzarik lebarek, kemo sheen tzarik lebarek al shear debarim habbaim mechamat hasseuda shemmebiim achar gemar hasseuda, lepi shenniptarim bebirkat "hammotzi", mittaam shennitbaer. Abal bimqomot sheen darkam liqboa shetiyya achar hasseuda qodem birkat hammazon bisudot gedolot, ap sheshshotin yayin bigmar hasseuda kesheokelin mine megadim, kevan sheen qobein atzman lishtiyya — en tzarik lachazor ulebarek, ki gam shetiyya zo hi tzorek hasseuda, umittechilla haya dato gam aleha lepotrah bebirkat hayyayin shebberak betok hasseuda). Vekol zeh bayyayin shelleachar hasseuda, abal kol mah sheshshoteh betok hasseuda day lo bibraka achat bekol inyan, apillu bistam, ella im ken yodea shehu nimlak:

Vaapillu hamlakat sapeq shemah hamlaka, kegon mi shenniknas lebet chabero veyesh sham chabura shemmesubbin lishtiyya, vehoshitu lo kos uberak alayv, veachar kak hoshitu lo kos acher — tzarik lachazor ulebarek al hashsheni ki keshebberak al harishon lo haya yodea im yittenu lo, kevan shehu eno qabua immahem lishtiyya. Apillu lo shata adayin kol hakkos shennatenu lo techilla, vehoshitu lo kos acher beod shehaya etzlo yayin mikkos harishon — tzarik lebarek al hakkos haacher shehoshitu lo. Mah sheen ken mi shehaya qabua im hamsubbin vehebiu lo kos beod shehaya lepanayv mikkos harishon, ap al pi shello haya yodea sheyyabiu od yayin bisuda zo achar shekkebar hitchilu lishtot (velo hayu yodeim im yabiu od yayin, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman r"v), mikkol maqom, meachar shehaya qabua im hamsubbin, veyesh qeba lishtiyyat yayin shellipamim adam qobea atzmo al hayyayin venigrar mishshetiyya lishtiyya veshoteh yoter mimmah shehekin barishona, hare haya bedato mittechilla sheim yabiu lo yoter yishteh mehem, veen zeh nimlak, meachar sheyyodea sheim yabiu od yittenu lo gam ken. Abal im eno yodea kelal im yittenu lo — hare zeh nimlak missapeq. Veken bisudot gedolot shehamsubbim rabbim, veyesh bahem anashim shemmistappeqim im yaggia lahem hakkos — tzerikim hamsuppaqim lebarek al kol kos:

Abal im haya dato beperush beshaa shebberak al hakkos harishon sheyyetze bebirkato al kol mah sheyyittenu lo yoter, apillu im haya sapeq lo im yittenu lo kelal, ella shehayeta dato sheim yittenu lo yoter yetze yede chobato bibraka zo — en tzarik lebarek al kos haacher sheyyoshitu lo. Veken im berak echad lekullam al derek sheyyitbaer besiman ry"g, venitkavven hamsuppaq sheim yittenu lo yetze bebirkato shel hambarek — en tzarik lebarek al hakkos sheyyoshitu lo. Umikkol maqom, lekattechilla en linhog kak sheyyebarek echad lekullam betok hasseuda, mishshum sheen bet habbelia panuy, veen datam lishmoa habberaka mippi hambarek, vegam lo yukelu laanot acharayv amen sheyyetzeu bebirkato, ki en mesichin basseuda, shemma yaqdim qaneh leveshet venimtza ba lide sakkana. Lepikak, im omer lahem: "sabri maranan", kelomar tenu datekem labberaka latzet yede chobatkem, kede sheyyepannu bet habbelia veyanichu akilatam veyittenu datam lishmoa habberaka veyaanu amen — echad mebarek lekullam. Veken nohagin. Umittaam zeh nitpashshet hamminhag bekol maqom shemmebarekin al hayyayin, kegon beqiddush vehabdala, im echad mebarek lekullam latzet bebirkato — omer "sabri maranan", velo "birshut maranan", kede shello lachaloq bebirkat hayyayin ben im mebarekin shello bishat hasseuda uben yayin habba lahem betok hasseuda: chaser baheteq siman qa"h vqa"v. Ak harotzeh laamod al iqqaran shel debarim, yimtza bassiddur [leqamman beseder birkat hannehenin shebbesop hakkerek], hakkol katub umeporash beli shum chissaron, dehaynu mah sheshshayyak lesiman qa"h yimtza bepereq y"b misseip y"g ad seip (y"t) [k"a], umah sheshshayyak lesiman qa"v yimtza bepereq d' misseip y"a ad sop happereq.
